description: This Java class `ProductAttributeEntity` extends `ProductAttribute` and represents an entity related to product attributes within a catalog, including fields for pricing, weight, sort order, and default status.

classes.name: ProductAttributeEntity
classes.description: Entity class for product attribute with additional properties such as price, weight, and default attribute indicator.

methods.name: setProductAttributePrice
methods.description: Sets the price attribute of the product attribute entity.

methods.name: getProductAttributePrice
methods.description: Retrieves the price attribute of the product attribute entity.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sorting order for the product attribute.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Gets the sorting order for the product attribute.

methods.name: setProductAttributeWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight attribute of the product attribute entity.

methods.name: getProductAttributeWeight
methods.description: Retrieves the weight attribute of the product attribute entity.

methods.name: setAttributeDefault
methods.description: Sets whether this attribute is the default.

methods.name: isAttributeDefault
methods.description: Checks if this attribute is set as default.
